concept: Helping take care of shared spaces, like a classroom or playground, because they belong to everyone
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Tokkatsu-style shared-space responsibility principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character helps clean up or take care of a shared space without being asked
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why might the character have done this even though it wasn't only their mess?
exercise.practice: Student names one shared space they use and one way they could help take care of it

assessment.success_marker: student names a real shared space and a specific, realistic action
